description: Land Title Settlement Department - Tholambugolla, Galewela, Matale District   -  Cad. Map No. 310085
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership determinations, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
